items.title: 68089_John Malachi oral history interview
items.q: And immediately, they started to talk to me about coming over

ctx.x: I don't know whose it was. I guess it was some person that was an Army officer or something. It wasn't any of their band. They were just... But anyway, when I went up there they had this band. And immediately, they started to talk to me about coming over, and there was the opportunity for coming over and joining that band with all these people in it. I'd just left 52nd Street, and I was out here with no...you know, without that kind of discipline and all that.

Plus, the first night that we went in the Navy, after we went through some kind of cleaning inspection -- that's what you go through when you first enter there... Then that night, we were in these barracks, and the barracks were all Black guys in there. And an incident happened that just made me almost convinced that something had to happen for me to get out of there. We had a bunch of new recruits, all of us.
